body.Title: PM-0001
body.measure_name: Good jobs and skills: overall assessment
body.description: Quarterly narrative judgement on progress across the good jobs measures.
body.definition: Owner's summary of measures 1.01 to 1.03, agreed at the quarterly board.

body.Title: PM-0002
body.description: Residents who started paid work after support from a GM employment programme.
body.definition: Count of job starts verified by providers in the month. Excludes starts under 16 hours a week.

body.Title: PM-0003
body.description: Share of apprentices who complete and pass their apprenticeship.
body.definition: Achievements divided by leavers in the quarter, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0004
body.description: Employers signed up as members of the Good Employment Charter.
body.definition: Count of member organisations on the last day of the month.

body.Title: PM-0005
body.measure_name: Housing supply summary: net additional homes
body.description: All net additional homes delivered across Greater Manchester.
body.definition: Net additions (new build plus conversions minus demolitions) in the financial year.

body.Title: PM-0006
body.description: Affordable homes completed. Shares reference 1.01 with its parent in the source plan.
body.definition: Completions of social rent, affordable rent and shared ownership homes in the financial year.

body.Title: PM-0007
body.description: Households living in temporary accommodation at month end.
body.definition: Snapshot count on the last day of the month across the ten councils.

body.Title: PM-0008
body.description: People found sleeping rough on a single autumn night.
body.definition: Official autumn count or estimate, summed across the ten councils.

body.Title: PM-0009
body.description: Passenger journeys on franchised bus services.
body.definition: Boardings recorded by ticket machines, Monday to Sunday.

body.Title: PM-0010
body.description: Share of timed stops served between 1 minute early and 5 minutes late.
body.definition: On-time departures divided by all timed departures, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0011
body.description: Calls answered by the customer contact centre.
body.definition: Answered inbound calls, 08:00 to 18:00.

body.Title: PM-0012
body.description: Share of the day the public website was available.
body.definition: Minutes available divided by 1,440, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0013
body.description: Revenue spend in the month. Under and overspend are both a concern, so no RAG.
body.definition: Actual revenue expenditure posted to the ledger for the month.

body.Title: PM-0014
body.description: Greenhouse gas emissions in kilotonnes CO2 equivalent.
body.definition: Territorial emissions within the scope of influence of local authorities, ktCO2e.

body.Title: PM-0015
body.description: Sessions attended as a share of possible sessions.
body.definition: Attended sessions divided by possible sessions, times 100, all state schools.

body.Title: PM-0016
body.description: Pupils missing 10% or more of possible sessions.
body.definition: Persistently absent pupils divided by all pupils, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0017
body.measure_name: 16 and 17 year olds not in education, employment or training
body.description: Share of 16 and 17 year olds who are NEET or whose activity is not known.
body.definition: December to February average, NEET plus not known, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0018
body.description: Learners starting a Skills Bootcamp.
body.definition: Learners who attended the first session in the quarter.

body.Title: PM-0019
body.description: Data and analysis requests closed within the agreed 10 working days.
body.definition: Requests closed within SLA divided by all requests closed in the week, times 100.

body.Title: PM-0020
body.measure_name: Gender pay gap report published on time
body.description: Whether the statutory gender pay gap report was published by the deadline.
body.definition: 1 if published by the statutory deadline, otherwise 0.

body.Title: PM-0021
body.description: Residents attending jobs fairs and recruitment events.
body.definition: Unique attendees signed in at events in the month.
body.retired_reason: Replaced by measure 1.01 when events moved into the employment programme.

body.Title: PM-0022
body.description: Temporary accommodation case reviews completed.
body.definition: Reviews signed off by a team leader in the fortnight.

body.Title: PRB-00001
body.problem_statement: Three councils send monthly returns after the 20th, which delays job start figures.

body.Title: PRB-00002
body.problem_statement: Two teams count job starts differently, so totals do not reconcile.

body.Title: PRB-00003
body.problem_statement: The dashboard needs about two hours of manual fixes after each refresh.
body.resolution: Fixed at source and a check added to the monthly routine.

body.Title: PRB-00004
body.problem_title: No agreed baseline for two new measures
body.problem_statement: Baselines for the new charter measures have not been signed off.

body.Title: PRB-00005
body.problem_title: Portal access requests taking too long
body.problem_statement: New starters wait over a week for access to the data portal.

body.Title: PRB-00006
body.problem_title: Duplicate records in the master list
body.problem_statement: About 4% of employer records are duplicated.

body.Title: PRB-00007
body.problem_statement: Two working days between data lock and board pack deadline is not enough.

body.Title: PRB-00008
body.problem_title: Oldham depot missing from bus extract
body.problem_statement: The on-time extract dropped one depot for a fortnight.
body.resolution: Fixed at source and a check added to the monthly routine.
